what: Agentic delegate launch omits git working-tree cwd contract
scenario_or_breakage: `evaluate_failure` will subprocess `ci agentic-fix` but the plan never requires `runner.run(..., cwd=repo_root)` or a `--repo-root` argv; `RunContext.repo` is the GitHub slug, not a filesystem path, so git/verify/push inside the delegate can run in the wrong directory
suggested_fix: Document and implement that `evaluate_failure` passes the parent `cwd` into the subprocess invocation (or add `--repo-root` to `ci agentic-fix` and thread it through every git call)
